verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no power envelope (TBP/TDP) for the MI355X and contains no independent performance-per-watt testing. The community benchmarks cover throughput (tok/s) and cost per hour only, not energy efficiency. AMD SMI and the Device Metrics Exporter are generic monitoring tools, which makes them adjacent controls rather than documented power envelopes or efficiency data.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
